scope: Independent synthetic parser, bus and routing fixtures. Supplied-ROM verification is separate.

results.name: Installed Lolo profile uses the existing read-only catalog and keeps the schema boundary
Filename, header and caller-supplied hashes cannot authorize unknown audio data
Structural parser preserves explicit durations, relative pitch and counted-repeat termination
Structural call/return and indefinite jumps remain bounded without inventing a timed score
Only the explicit MMC1 unused-FDS bus policy ignores expansion writes; other bus guards remain strict
Music and SFX dispatch through separate native entries and retain isolated execution
Immutable audio-prefix recognition uses a typed physical read through the shared method context
Repeated Lolo previews are deterministic and invalid update windows refuse
